name: digiface1m
source: DigiFace-1M (Bae et al., 'DigiFace-1M: 1 Million Digital Face Images for Face Recognition', WACV 2023; Microsoft, https://github.com/microsoft/DigiFace1M). raw/subjects_*.zip are the eight official parts (README links https://facesyntheticspubwedata.z6.web.core.windows.net/wacv-2023/<name>.zip); LICENSE.txt is the repository's licence file. Read directly from the zips (members '<id>/<k>.png'), not extracted.

counts.layout: 10,000 ids x 72 images (subjects 0-9999) + 99,999 ids x 5 images (subjects 100000-199998)
counts.image_format: 112x112 RGBA PNG (alpha 255 on a 600-image sample), ArcFace-style aligned (SCRFD kps on a sample: mean 1.6-4 px from the ArcFace template)
counts.used_by: E2 gallery distractors: 4 seeded images per identity (439,996 images, all decoded), embed_aligned, no detector

notes: SYNTHETIC (rendered 3D faces): no identity overlap with real training sets, but also not real customers; its impostor scores against real probes are reported separately in E2 and are not used for the 1M extrapolation.
